decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap variant of the core offer that matches current design trends, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The shower channel for seamless coverings is central to the barrier-free bathroom strategy and has a page of its own, so it likely meets aspirations.

The pump-assisted line is only mentioned on the website and its results are still uncertain, and the newer pump-drain channel F may overlap with it, but slack lets the firm carry it for renovation cases where gravity drainage is not possible.
The stainless steel design grate fits the design-led positioning and the firm's own metal manufacturing at little extra cost, and there is no sign of a shortfall.
The newly launched pump-drain shower channel has a page of its own and extends the pump-drainage offer, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations and slack lets the firm carry it.
